_comment: Editable rules mapping Cetera AdviceWorks document titles to filename summaries. They are checked in order, tax (unused), then insurance (unused), then statement. cetera_site.py titles a statement 'Cetera <statement name> <date>' and a report 'Cetera Quarterly Performance Report <year> Q<n> <date>', and a statement's file name then adds its masked account number. A confirmation or a tax form the statements list may hold is left out by its own name, a tax form by its form number, so one named a statement is still not filed as one.
